_comment: ESEF measurement v2 ratchet baseline (ADR 0112, #331). Aggregate NUMBERS ONLY — never a ticker, title, id, filename or value (ADR 0091 dec. 4). Measured 2026-09-14 by src-tauri/src/storage/tests/real_data_esef_v2.rs on the owner's private corpus (2026-09-10 snapshot; ground truth second-read in two blinded adjudication rounds), judged by scripts/check/realdata-ratchet.mjs --profile esef via `make realdata-esef-check` (advisory ritual, never a required check). The matching private keyed baseline was promoted with `make realdata-esef-promote`; any change to the key map, normalization list, ground truth or corpus bumps measurement_version and needs a deliberate rebaseline.
